name: Colossal Cave Mountain Park
note: Pima County-owned park (concession-run) on Old Spanish Trail east of Vail. RV/car camping $15 per vehicle per night, first-come first-served, at about 30 individual sites in Posta Quemada canyon (CCC-built picnic areas El Bosquecito and La Selvilla, with tables and grills; water and restrooms there). No hookups. Check in and pay at the Cave Shop first; park hours 8am-4pm and the front gates are locked at night. Pin is the cave parking lot; the camping areas are in the canyon below it and could not be located precisely. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator camp page (colossalcave.com/camp-picnic, read 2026-10-05): 'RV, Car and Horse Trailer Camping: $15 per vehicle/night', 30 individual sites, FCFS, water and restrooms at El Bosquecito and La Selvilla, no hookups; AWH 2026-10-05 saw a video of a rig larger than EKKO in a defined campsite with a parking pad and picnic table - settles the 23-ft fit. Local gap found by the AZ private pass (RV Life lists it commercial, 4* over 4)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 1.4 km frame) at 32.0560,-110.6345: Posta Quemada canyon is a dry desert wash lined with mesquite; no standing or flowing water at any camping area - not waterfront
